title: Quantum-Secure Pseudorandom Permutation Construction
summary: The source reports no known construction and leaves the construction of a quantum-secure pseudorandom permutation unresolved.

scope.domain: Quantum-secure symmetric-key cryptography and the design of cryptographic primitives.
scope.unresolved_remainder: A construction of a quantum-secure pseudorandom permutation remains to be found.
